content.title: How to watch the 2026 Oscars: Where to stream the Academy Awards tonight, start time, full nominations list and more
content.text: The 98th Academy Awards are this Sunday, and Sinners leads the nominees with 16 nods — the most in Oscars history! One Battle After Another follows with 13 nominations. Marty Supreme, Frankenstein, Sentimental Value, and Hamnet are also high up in the mix. This awards will once again be hosted by Conan O'Brien, and performers will include K-Pop Demon Hunters' HUNTR/X and Sinners star Miles Caton. The awards kick off slightly earlier than usual: 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT on March 15, 2026.The 2026 Oscars will air on ABC and stream live on Hulu — yes, even for a basic, ad-supported subscription that usually features no live TV (and right now, you can get a deal on the Hulu and Disney+ bundle, just $4.99 a month). Here’s everything you need to know about watching the 2026 Oscars.Looking for live Oscars red carpet updates? Yahoo Entertainment has you covered.When are the Oscars this year?The 98th Academy Awards will be held this Sunday, March 15.2026 Oscars start timeThe Oscars begin at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT. Red carpet coverage starts at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.2026 Oscars TV channelThe Oscars will air on ABC and stream live on Hulu, even for those without a live TV subscription.Where to stream the 2026 Oscars: Will the Oscars be on Disney+?No. While Hulu and Disney+ have essentially merged content (for bundle subscribers), to stream the Academy Awards live on Hulu, you need to be signed into your bundle account via Hulu (not Disney+).Who is hosting the Oscars this year?Conan O'Brien returns to host the Oscars for the second year.Who is presenting at the Oscars this year?Stars slated to present at this year's Academy Awards include Adrien Brody, Mikey Madison, Kieran Culkin, Zoe Saldaña, Javier Bardem, Chris Evans, Chase Infiniti, Demi Moore, Kumail Nanjiani, Maya Rudolph, Will Arnett, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Robert Downey Jr., Anne Hathaway, Paul Mescal and Gwyneth Paltrow.2026 Oscars performersOnly two of the nominated songs this year will be performed at the 2026 Oscars: "Golden" from K-Pop Demon Hunters and "I Lied To You" from Sinners. That means we'll see EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami (the voices of HUNTR/X), plus Miles Caton and Raphael Saadiq grace the stage this Sunday.2026 Oscar predictionsLooking for Oscars predictions ahead of the awards? We've got what you need to ace your ballot at this year's Academy Awards watch party.Who votes on Oscar nominations?Members of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences vote for Best Picture and
